entries.meaningZh: 足球运动
entries.en: We play football on the beach when the tide is low.
entries.zh: 退潮时，我们在海滩上踢足球。

entries.meaningZh: 做错的事情
entries.en: A small mistake in the address sent our parcel to another town.
entries.zh: 地址上的一个小错误使我们的包裹被送到了另一个镇。

entries.meaningZh: 答应要做到的事
entries.en: Lena kept her promise and returned the borrowed camera before sunset.
entries.zh: 莉娜遵守了承诺，在日落前归还了借来的相机。

entries.meaningZh: 安排好的一段活动时间
entries.en: The afternoon training session begins with ten minutes of gentle stretching.
entries.zh: 下午的训练课以十分钟的轻柔拉伸开始。

entries.meaningZh: 有资格参加选举投票的人
entries.en: Each voter received a paper ballot upon entering the school hall.
entries.zh: 每位选民进入学校礼堂时都领到了一张纸质选票。

entries.meaningZh: 程度越来越高地
entries.en: The mountain road became increasingly narrow as we approached the village.
entries.zh: 我们接近村庄时，山路变得越来越窄。

entries.meaningZh: 在竞争中获胜
entries.en: The exhausted runners celebrated their relay victory with a quiet group hug.
entries.zh: 筋疲力尽的跑步队员们静静地拥抱在一起，庆祝接力赛的胜利。

entries.meaningZh: 供观众观看戏剧演出的场所
entries.en: The old theatre still has velvet seats and a painted ceiling.
entries.zh: 那座老剧院仍保留着天鹅绒座椅和彩绘天花板。

entries.meaningZh: 国王或女王的儿子
entries.en: In the story, the young prince learns to mend his own clothes.
entries.zh: 故事中，年轻的王子学着自己缝补衣服。

entries.meaningZh: 需要偿还的借款
entries.en: They used a small bank loan to buy equipment for their bakery.
entries.zh: 他们用一笔小额银行贷款为面包店购置设备。

entries.meaningZh: 替某个群体表达意见的人
entries.en: Our class representative brought the timetable problem to the teachers' meeting.
entries.zh: 我们班的代表在教师会议上提出了课程表的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 平日经常如此的
entries.en: My usual bus stop was closed because workers were repairing the pavement.
entries.zh: 由于工人正在维修人行道，我平常乘车的公交站关闭了。

entries.meaningZh: 用相机拍下的影像
entries.en: This faded photograph shows my grandmother beside her first bicycle.
entries.zh: 这张褪色的照片拍下了奶奶站在她第一辆自行车旁的样子。

entries.meaningZh: 拒绝接受或同意
entries.en: The committee may reject the proposal if its costs remain unclear.
entries.zh: 如果费用仍不明确，委员会可能会否决这项提案。

entries.meaningZh: 骨头相互连接的部位
entries.en: The doctor gently moved my elbow to check the injured joint.
entries.zh: 医生轻轻活动我的肘部，检查受伤的关节。

entries.meaningZh: 用来黏合物品的带状材料
entries.en: Please seal the torn envelope with a short strip of tape.
entries.zh: 请用一小条胶带封好撕破的信封。

entries.meaningZh: 从云中落下的水滴
entries.en: Heavy rain drummed on the roof while we sorted the camping gear.
entries.zh: 我们整理露营装备时，大雨咚咚地敲打着屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 能带来帮助的优点或资源
entries.en: Her calm voice was an asset during the crowded station evacuation.
entries.zh: 在拥挤车站的疏散过程中，她镇定的声音起到了帮助作用。

entries.meaningZh: 仔细寻找某人或某物
entries.en: We must search every cupboard before buying another tin of paint.
entries.zh: 我们必须先找遍每个橱柜，再买一罐油漆。

entries.meaningZh: 位于东边的
entries.en: Morning sunlight reaches the eastern side of the house first.
entries.zh: 早晨的阳光最先照到房子的东侧。

entries.meaningZh: 集中制造产品的生产场所
entries.en: The glass factory offers weekend tours led by retired workers.
entries.zh: 那家玻璃工厂提供由退休工人带领的周末参观活动。

entries.meaningZh: 提醒别人注意可能的危险
entries.en: Bright signs warn walkers that loose stones may fall from the cliff.
entries.zh: 醒目的标牌提醒步行者，松动的石块可能从悬崖掉落。

entries.meaningZh: 为某项活动提供资金
entries.en: The village hopes to finance its new playground through a summer fair.
entries.zh: 村里希望通过夏季集市为新游乐场筹措资金。

entries.meaningZh: 强制要求他人接受
entries.en: The landlord cannot impose extra charges without explaining them in writing.
entries.zh: 房东不能在未作书面说明的情况下强行收取额外费用。

entries.meaningZh: 能够在空中飞行的交通工具
entries.en: A small aircraft carried supplies to the island after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，一架小型飞机把物资运到了岛上。

entries.meaningZh: 对权力或资源的不当使用
entries.en: The new rules aim to prevent abuse of the shared printing allowance.
entries.zh: 新规定旨在防止公用打印额度被滥用。

entries.meaningZh: 按次序排在第四位的
entries.en: Our team finished fourth, just two seconds behind the bronze medal winners.
entries.zh: 我们队获得第四名，仅比铜牌得主慢两秒。

entries.meaningZh: 强烈想要某事的心情
entries.en: A desire to understand birds led him to study their songs.
entries.zh: 想要了解鸟类的愿望促使他研究鸟鸣。

entries.meaningZh: 燃烧后能提供能量的物质
entries.en: The hikers carried enough fuel to cook meals for three days.
entries.zh: 徒步旅行者携带了足够做三天饭的燃料。

entries.meaningZh: 证明乘车或入场资格的凭证
entries.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the museum's final exhibition room.
entries.zh: 在离开博物馆最后一个展厅前，请保留门票。

entries.meaningZh: 认为合适而向人介绍
entries.en: Could you recommend a quiet café where I can read after work?
entries.zh: 你能推荐一家安静的咖啡馆，让我下班后读书吗？

entries.meaningZh: 一天中午吃的一餐
entries.en: We packed lunch in reusable boxes before setting off for the lake.
entries.zh: 出发去湖边前，我们把午餐装进了可重复使用的饭盒。

entries.meaningZh: 指出不足或表达不赞同的意见
entries.en: His criticism of the poster focused on its unreadable lettering.
entries.zh: 他对海报的批评集中在难以辨认的字体上。

entries.meaningZh: 分布在某物的四周
entries.en: Tall pine trees surround the cabin and shelter it from strong winds.
entries.zh: 高大的松树环绕着小木屋，为它遮挡强风。

entries.meaningZh: 结束争端的解决协议
entries.en: After weeks of discussion, both neighbours accepted a settlement over the fence.
entries.zh: 经过数周讨论，两位邻居接受了关于围栏争议的和解协议。

entries.meaningZh: 某时某地的气象情况
entries.en: The weather improved enough for us to move dinner onto the terrace.
entries.zh: 天气好转了，我们得以把晚餐搬到露台上吃。

entries.meaningZh: 播放特定电视节目的频道
entries.en: This channel broadcasts nature programmes without advertisements during the evening.
entries.zh: 这个频道晚间播放自然节目，期间不插播广告。

entries.meaningZh: 了解公众意见的调查
entries.en: A recent poll asked residents whether the main street needed more trees.
entries.zh: 最近一项民意调查询问居民，主街是否需要种更多树。

entries.meaningZh: 专门从事研究或教育的机构
entries.en: The marine institute keeps detailed records of water temperatures along this coast.
entries.zh: 这家海洋研究所详细记录了这一带海岸的水温。

entries.meaningZh: 不以君主为国家元首的国家。
entries.en: The fictional republic chooses a new president every five years.
entries.zh: 这个虚构的共和国每五年选举一位新总统。

entries.meaningZh: 群体中人数较少的部分
entries.en: Only a minority of passengers wanted the windows kept open.
entries.zh: 只有少数乘客希望窗户保持开着。

entries.meaningZh: 发生可能性很小的
entries.en: With so little flour left, a second batch of bread seems unlikely.
entries.zh: 面粉剩得这么少，看来不太可能再烤一批面包。

entries.meaningZh: 篇幅较长的虚构故事作品
entries.en: The novel follows three sisters who inherit a remote mountain inn.
entries.zh: 这部长篇小说讲述了继承偏远山中旅馆的三姐妹的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 供读写或办公使用的桌子
entries.en: I moved my desk closer to the window for better afternoon light.
entries.zh: 我把书桌移近窗户，以便下午有更好的光线。

entries.meaningZh: 国家之间正式订立的协议
entries.en: The treaty allowed fishing boats from both countries to use the harbour.
entries.zh: 该条约允许两国的渔船使用这个港口。

entries.meaningZh: 为克服困难而费力行动
entries.en: Young seedlings struggle to grow beneath the shade of larger trees.
entries.zh: 幼苗在大树的阴影下艰难生长。

entries.meaningZh: 研究资料并作出判断的人
entries.en: The analyst compared passenger numbers before suggesting a later bus service.
entries.zh: 分析员比较了乘客数量后，建议增开一班更晚的公交车。

entries.meaningZh: 负责指挥船只的人
entries.en: The captain delayed departure until the thick fog cleared from the harbour.
entries.zh: 船长推迟了出航，直到港口的浓雾散去。

entries.meaningZh: 从被困或危险处脱离
entries.en: The kitten managed to escape through a gap beneath the garden gate.
entries.zh: 小猫设法从花园门下面的缝隙逃了出去。

entries.meaningZh: 通过查证寻找事情的原因
entries.en: Engineers will investigate why the bridge lights stopped working last night.
entries.zh: 工程师将调查桥上的灯昨晚停止工作的原因。

entries.meaningZh: 负责某方面事务的政府部门
entries.en: The education ministry published new guidance on school meals this morning.
entries.zh: 教育部今早发布了关于学校膳食的新指导意见。

entries.meaningZh: 所说的两者全都不
entries.en: I tried both keys, but neither would open the old wooden chest.
entries.zh: 我试过了两把钥匙，但哪把都打不开那个旧木箱。

entries.meaningZh: 未来可能发生的好事
entries.en: The prospect of a warm meal kept the tired walkers moving.
entries.zh: 能吃上一顿热饭的盼头让疲惫的行人继续前进。

entries.meaningZh: 必须立即处理的危险情况
entries.en: During an emergency, this door provides a direct route to the courtyard.
entries.zh: 发生紧急情况时，这扇门提供一条直达庭院的通道。

entries.meaningZh: 令人紧张或焦虑的精神压力
entries.en: Walking beside the river helps Mira relieve the stress of exam preparation.
entries.zh: 沿河散步有助于米拉缓解备考的压力。

entries.meaningZh: 愿意接受不同观念的
entries.en: My grandfather has surprisingly liberal views about how young people should dress.
entries.zh: 爷爷对年轻人该如何穿着持有出人意料的开明看法。

entries.meaningZh: 达到希望实现的结果
entries.en: The rescue may succeed if the wind drops before nightfall.
entries.zh: 如果风在天黑前减弱，救援就可能成功。

entries.meaningZh: 可用来替代的另一种选择
entries.en: Cycling offers a cheaper alternative to driving across the city every day.
entries.zh: 与每天开车穿城相比，骑自行车提供了一个更便宜的选择。

entries.meaningZh: 正式同意或准许
entries.en: The council must approve the plans before construction can begin.
entries.zh: 市议会必须批准这些计划，工程才能开工。

entries.meaningZh: 供飞机起降和旅客乘机的场所
entries.en: We reached the airport early enough to watch planes through the windows.
entries.zh: 我们很早就到了机场，还有时间透过窗户看飞机。

entries.meaningZh: 以参与政治事务为职业的人
entries.en: The local politician answered questions about housing at the community centre.
entries.zh: 这位地方政治人物在社区中心回答了有关住房的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 发生的一件引人注意的事情
entries.en: The missing bicycle incident turned out to be a simple misunderstanding.
entries.zh: 自行车失踪事件最后证明只是一个简单的误会。

entries.meaningZh: 比赛或竞争中取得第一的人
entries.en: The winner received a handmade cup from the youngest member of the club.
entries.zh: 获胜者从俱乐部年龄最小的成员手中接过了一个手工奖杯。

entries.meaningZh: 通过投票选出任职者
entries.en: Club members will elect a new treasurer at Friday's annual meeting.
entries.zh: 俱乐部成员将在周五的年会上选出一位新财务主管。

entries.meaningZh: 美国一个州的最高行政长官
entries.en: The governor visited several towns affected by the flooding along the river.
entries.zh: 州长走访了河边几个遭受洪灾的城镇。

entries.meaningZh: 向他人提出的要求
entries.en: Your request for a quieter room has been passed to reception.
entries.zh: 你想换一间更安静客房的请求已转交前台。

entries.meaningZh: 协助或代替负责人工作的人
entries.en: The director's deputy chaired the meeting while she visited the new site.
entries.zh: 主管去视察新场地时，她的副手主持了会议。

entries.meaningZh: 将某人或某物排除在外
entries.en: Every shelf was empty except the one holding a chipped blue vase.
entries.zh: 每个架子都空了，只有放着一只缺口蓝花瓶的那个例外。

entries.meaningZh: 在另一件事进行的同时
entries.en: The soup simmered on the stove; meanwhile, Arun chopped vegetables for tomorrow.
entries.zh: 汤在炉上慢炖；与此同时，阿伦在切明天要用的蔬菜。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未让他人知道的事情
entries.en: The children kept their birthday surprise a secret for almost a month.
entries.zh: 孩子们把生日惊喜保密了将近一个月。

entries.meaningZh: 比赛中夺得的冠军头衔
entries.en: Her first national championship came after years of training on public courts.
entries.zh: 在公共球场训练多年后，她首次获得了全国冠军头衔。

entries.meaningZh: 人与人之间的紧密联系
entries.en: Caring for the injured dog created a strong bond between the neighbours.
entries.zh: 照顾受伤的小狗让邻居们建立了深厚的情谊。

entries.meaningZh: 指称某人做了不好的事
entries.en: You should check the receipts before you accuse anyone of taking money.
entries.zh: 在指责任何人拿钱之前，你应该先核查收据。

entries.meaningZh: 使机器运转的动力装置
entries.en: The fan's motor made a low humming sound throughout the night.
entries.zh: 整晚，电扇的电动机都发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

entries.meaningZh: 为达成协议而进行的商谈
entries.en: Patient negotiation helped the two shops agree on shared delivery times.
entries.zh: 耐心的协商帮助两家商店就共用的送货时间达成了一致。

entries.meaningZh: 植物可萌发长大的颗粒
entries.en: A single sunflower seed had sprouted in the crack beside our doorstep.
entries.zh: 一粒向日葵种子在我们门阶旁的缝隙里发芽了。

entries.meaningZh: 从账户中取出钱款
entries.en: I need to withdraw some cash before visiting the outdoor market.
entries.zh: 去露天市场之前，我需要取一些现金。

entries.meaningZh: 让人感到非常糟糕的
entries.en: The terrible smell disappeared after we cleared the blocked kitchen drain.
entries.zh: 我们疏通厨房堵塞的下水道后，那股难闻的气味消失了。

entries.meaningZh: 被关在监狱中的人
entries.en: The prisoner borrowed a history book from the small prison library.
entries.zh: 那名囚犯从监狱的小图书室借了一本历史书。

entries.meaningZh: 比赛中赢得最高名次的人
entries.en: The chess champion stayed afterward to play friendly games with local children.
entries.zh: 这位国际象棋冠军赛后留下来，与当地孩子们下友谊棋。

entries.meaningZh: 与违反刑法有关的
entries.en: The lawyer explained the difference between a civil case and a criminal case.
entries.zh: 律师解释了民事案件与刑事案件之间的区别。

entries.meaningZh: 一个人平时摄入的食物
entries.en: Fresh vegetables and beans make up much of my grandmother's diet.
entries.zh: 新鲜蔬菜和豆类在奶奶的日常饮食中占很大比重。

entries.meaningZh: 认真下定的行动决心
entries.en: My resolution to waste less food began with planning smaller meals.
entries.zh: 我从计划分量更小的餐食开始，实践少浪费食物的决心。

entries.meaningZh: 占用某一空间
entries.en: The piano will occupy most of the space beside the staircase.
entries.zh: 钢琴将占据楼梯旁的大部分空间。

entries.meaningZh: 能爆炸并造成破坏的装置
entries.en: Workers discovered an old bomb while digging near the abandoned railway station.
entries.zh: 工人在废弃火车站附近挖掘时发现了一枚旧炸弹。

entries.meaningZh: 动物占据并保护的活动区域
entries.en: The fox marked its territory along the edge of the orchard.
entries.zh: 狐狸沿着果园边缘标记自己的领地。

entries.meaningZh: 物价总体持续上涨的现象
entries.en: Rising inflation made the same weekly shopping basket noticeably more expensive.
entries.zh: 通货膨胀加剧，使同样的一周购物清单花费明显增加。

entries.meaningZh: 某方面表现突出的天赋能力
entries.en: Her talent for drawing appeared in the detailed maps she made for friends.
entries.zh: 她为朋友画的精细地图展现了她的绘画天赋。

entries.meaningZh: 原样引用别人的话
entries.en: Please quote the complete sentence so readers can understand the author's point.
entries.zh: 请引用完整的句子，好让读者理解作者的意思。

entries.meaningZh: 在某领域占据明显优势
entries.en: Large supermarkets dominate food sales in the suburbs around our town.
entries.zh: 大型超市在我们镇周边郊区的食品销售中占据主导地位。

entries.meaningZh: 各方意见不一致引起的争执
entries.en: A dispute over parking spaces delayed the opening of the new clinic.
entries.zh: 关于停车位的争议推迟了新诊所的开业。

entries.meaningZh: 采访并报道新闻的人
entries.en: The journalist spent a week interviewing fishermen about changes in the bay.
entries.zh: 这名记者花了一周时间采访渔民，了解海湾的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 根据迹象推想可能如此
entries.en: I suspect the cat knocked the plant over while we were outside.
entries.zh: 我怀疑我们在外面时，是猫把那盆植物碰倒了。

entries.meaningZh: 一个国家使用的钱币体系
entries.en: We exchanged a little money for local currency before leaving the airport.
entries.zh: 离开机场前，我们兑换了少量当地货币。

entries.meaningZh: 变化明显而令人惊讶的
entries.en: The repaired windows made a dramatic difference to the warmth of the room.
entries.zh: 修好的窗户让房间暖和了许多，变化十分明显。

entries.meaningZh: 因表现出色而获得的奖品
entries.en: The first prize was a basket filled with locally grown fruit.
entries.zh: 一等奖是一篮当地种植的水果。

entries.meaningZh: 提供航空客货运输的公司
entries.en: The airline moved our flight to an earlier time without changing the fare.
entries.zh: 航空公司把我们的航班改到了更早的时间，票价没有改变。

entries.meaningZh: 执法人员拘捕嫌疑人的行为
entries.en: The arrest followed several weeks of investigation into the missing museum coins.
entries.zh: 对博物馆硬币失踪案进行了数周调查后，警方实施了逮捕。

entries.meaningZh: 安排各项活动时间的计划表
entries.en: Our revised schedule leaves an hour for lunch between the two workshops.
entries.zh: 修改后的日程表在两场工作坊之间留了一小时午餐时间。

entries.meaningZh: 代表组织公开发表意见的人
entries.en: A company spokesman confirmed that the damaged bridge would remain closed overnight.
entries.zh: 公司一名发言人证实，受损的桥梁将整夜保持关闭。

entries.meaningZh: 信奉共产主义理念的人
entries.en: The memoir describes how its author became a communist as a student.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描述了作者在学生时代如何成为一名共产主义者。

entries.meaningZh: 支付价款取得商品
entries.en: Visitors can purchase handmade notebooks from the small shop beside the gallery.
entries.zh: 游客可以在美术馆旁的小店购买手工笔记本。

entries.meaningZh: 集中收录照片的册子
entries.en: My uncle brought an album of photographs from his years at sea.
entries.zh: 叔叔带来了一本相册，收录了他多年航海期间的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 在工作中管理其他人的人
entries.en: My boss rearranged the shifts so everyone could attend the farewell lunch.
entries.zh: 我的上司重新安排了班次，让每个人都能参加欢送午餐。

entries.meaningZh: 公开表达反对意见的行动
entries.en: Residents held a peaceful protest against plans to close the public swimming pool.
entries.zh: 居民举行和平抗议，反对关闭公共游泳池的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 把商品销往别的国家
entries.en: Several farms export fresh cherries to neighbouring countries during the summer harvest.
entries.zh: 夏季收获期间，几家农场向邻国出口新鲜樱桃。

entries.meaningZh: 突然产生的强烈愿望
entries.en: I felt an urge to sketch the abandoned house before it disappeared.
entries.zh: 我突然很想在那座废弃房屋消失前把它画下来。

entries.meaningZh: 经济活动持续下滑的时期
entries.en: During the recession, many shops reduced their opening hours to save money.
entries.zh: 经济衰退期间，许多商店缩短营业时间以节省开支。

entries.meaningZh: 激起某人的兴趣或行动意愿
entries.en: The visiting astronomer hoped to inspire children to explore the night sky.
entries.zh: 来访的天文学家希望激发孩子们探索夜空的兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: 从根本上大幅改变的
entries.en: Converting the car park into a garden required a radical change of plan.
entries.zh: 把停车场改成花园需要对计划作出根本性的调整。

entries.meaningZh: 集中举办庆祝或文艺活动的节庆
entries.en: The spring festival fills the riverside streets with music and paper lanterns.
entries.zh: 春季庆典让河边的街道充满音乐声，并挂满纸灯笼。

entries.meaningZh: 支出超过收入的差额
entries.en: The club covered its small deficit by selling old equipment at auction.
entries.zh: 俱乐部通过拍卖旧设备弥补了小额赤字。

entries.meaningZh: 支持并共同努力的伙伴
entries.en: The librarian became a valuable ally in our campaign for longer opening hours.
entries.zh: 在我们争取延长开放时间的行动中，图书管理员成了有力的支持者。

entries.meaningZh: 燃烧时产生的气体与微粒
entries.en: A thin column of smoke rose from the chimney above the snowy roof.
entries.zh: 一缕细烟从积雪屋顶上方的烟囱中升起。

entries.meaningZh: 次序排在第五位的
entries.en: The fifth drawer contains spare batteries, string, and a very old compass.
entries.zh: 第五个抽屉里装着备用电池、绳子和一个很旧的指南针。

entries.meaningZh: 与自己属于同一群体的
entries.en: A fellow passenger helped me lift the heavy suitcase onto the rack.
entries.zh: 一位同车乘客帮我把沉重的行李箱举上行李架。

entries.meaningZh: 提前安排留给某人使用
entries.en: Could we reserve a table near the window for Saturday evening?
entries.zh: 我们可以预订周六晚上一张靠窗的桌子吗？

entries.meaningZh: 以房产担保偿还的购房借款
entries.en: Their monthly mortgage payment became easier to manage after the salary increase.
entries.zh: 加薪后，他们每月的房贷还款更容易负担了。

entries.meaningZh: 记录个人经历或思考的本子
entries.en: Nina keeps a travel journal with drawings of every station she visits.
entries.zh: 妮娜记旅行日记，画下她到过的每一座车站。

entries.meaningZh: 某次出版发行的版本
entries.en: The latest edition includes a new chapter on restoring old wooden furniture.
entries.zh: 最新版新增了一章，介绍如何修复旧木家具。

entries.meaningZh: 商谈以争取双方接受的条件
entries.en: We hope to negotiate a lower rent before signing the shop lease.
entries.zh: 我们希望在签署店铺租约前协商一个更低的租金。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及物质性质或变化的
entries.en: The students observed a chemical reaction when the two clear liquids mixed.
entries.zh: 两种透明液体混合时，学生们观察到了一次化学反应。

entries.meaningZh: 比赛或争斗中输掉的结果
entries.en: Despite the defeat, our coach praised the team's patient and disciplined play.
entries.zh: 尽管输了比赛，教练仍赞扬了全队耐心而守纪律的表现。

entries.meaningZh: 父母的姐妹或兄弟的妻子
entries.en: My aunt taught me to knit during a long rainy holiday.
entries.zh: 在一个漫长多雨的假期里，我姨妈教我织毛线。

entries.meaningZh: 分成两个或更多部分
entries.en: We can split the journey into two days and visit the coast.
entries.zh: 我们可以把旅程分成两天，并去海边看看。

entries.meaningZh: 插在地上起支撑作用的桩
entries.en: Tie the young tree loosely to a wooden stake for support.
entries.zh: 把小树松松地绑在木桩上，以便支撑。

entries.meaningZh: 因危险而离开家园寻求保护的人
entries.en: The refugee described the garden she hoped to plant in her new home.
entries.zh: 这位难民描述了她希望在新家栽种的花园。

entries.meaningZh: 长期受到认可的优秀作品
entries.en: This short novel became a classic because generations of readers loved its honesty.
entries.zh: 这部篇幅较短的小说因一代代读者喜爱其真诚而成为经典。

entries.meaningZh: 国王或女王的女儿
entries.en: The princess in the play secretly trains as a shipbuilder.
entries.zh: 剧中的公主秘密地接受造船工匠的训练。

entries.meaningZh: 与自己同辈的堂亲或表亲
entries.en: My cousin and I learned to swim in the same village pool.
entries.zh: 我和表弟在村里的同一个泳池学会了游泳。

entries.meaningZh: 研究资源分配与经济活动的学科
entries.en: Studying economics helped her understand why housing prices differed between nearby towns.
entries.zh: 学习经济学帮助她理解了相邻城镇房价不同的原因。

entries.meaningZh: 车辆相撞造成的事故
entries.en: Nobody was injured in the crash, but both bicycles needed new wheels.
entries.zh: 碰撞事故中无人受伤，但两辆自行车都需要换新轮子。

entries.meaningZh: 山的最高点
entries.en: Clouds covered the summit before the climbers could take their final photograph.
entries.zh: 登山者还没来得及拍最后一张照片，云就遮住了山顶。

entries.meaningZh: 从某地向媒体发回报道的记者
entries.en: Our foreign correspondent reported live from a crowded station near the border.
entries.zh: 我们的驻外记者在边境附近一个拥挤的车站进行了现场报道。

entries.meaningZh: 按顺序位于第六的
entries.en: On the sixth attempt, the paper airplane finally flew across the classroom.
entries.zh: 试到第六次时，纸飞机终于飞过了教室。

entries.meaningZh: 争取同一目标的竞争对手
entries.en: Her closest rival congratulated her warmly after the final swimming race.
entries.zh: 最后一场游泳比赛结束后，她最强的对手热情地向她祝贺。

entries.meaningZh: 失去支撑而突然倒下
entries.en: The old shed could collapse if we remove that central wooden beam.
entries.zh: 如果我们拆掉那根中央木梁，旧棚屋可能会倒塌。

entries.meaningZh: 正式给予许可或认可
entries.en: The board must sanction any purchase that exceeds the department's annual budget.
entries.zh: 凡是超过部门年度预算的采购，都必须得到董事会的正式批准。

entries.meaningZh: 反抗现有统治或权威的人
entries.en: The captured rebel refused to reveal where his companions were hiding.
entries.zh: 被俘的反叛者拒绝透露同伴的藏身之处。

entries.meaningZh: 在尚未证实时指称某事
entries.en: Several tenants allege that the landlord entered their rooms without permission.
entries.zh: 几名租户指称，房东未经允许进入了他们的房间。

entries.meaningZh: 顺序排到第二十的
entries.en: For her twentieth birthday, Eva took her first overnight train journey.
entries.zh: 二十岁生日时，伊娃第一次乘坐了过夜火车。

entries.meaningZh: 被扣押以迫使他人让步的人
entries.en: The released hostage thanked the neighbours who had supported his family.
entries.zh: 获释的人质感谢了那些曾经支持他家人的邻居。

entries.meaningZh: 在次序中排第七的
entries.en: The seventh question asked us to describe a place without naming it.
entries.zh: 第七道题要求我们描述一个地方，但不说出它的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 以英镑为单位的英国货币
entries.en: The invoice lists the total in sterling rather than in euros.
entries.zh: 发票上的总金额以英镑而非欧元列出。

entries.meaningZh: 按先后次序排在第八的
entries.en: An owl appears on the eighth page of the picture book.
entries.zh: 绘本的第八页上出现了一只猫头鹰。

entries.meaningZh: 顺序中的第九个
entries.en: The lift stopped at the ninth floor, where the music lesson was held.
entries.zh: 电梯停在九楼，音乐课就在那里上。

entries.meaningZh: 顺序中的第十个
entries.en: Our bakery is celebrating its tenth anniversary with free bread for neighbours.
entries.zh: 我们的面包店正向邻居免费赠送面包，庆祝开业十周年。

entries.meaningZh: 按顺序算到第十二的
entries.en: By the twelfth day, tiny green shoots had appeared in every pot.
entries.zh: 到第十二天时，每个花盆里都冒出了细小的绿芽。

entries.meaningZh: 附在图片旁解释内容的文字
entries.en: The caption beneath the photograph identifies each worker standing by the locomotive.
entries.zh: 照片下方的说明文字标明了站在机车旁的每位工人。

entries.meaningZh: 为获得机会而提交的申请
entries.en: Her application included a short letter explaining her interest in marine conservation.
entries.zh: 她的申请中包含一封短信，说明她对海洋保护的兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: 协助安排日常办公事务的人
entries.en: The secretary found a free room and sent everyone the meeting details.
entries.zh: 秘书找到了一间空闲会议室，并把会议详情发给了所有人。

entries.meaningZh: 因可能出问题而担忧的
entries.en: We became concerned when the usually cheerful dog refused its evening meal.
entries.zh: 那只平时活泼的狗不肯吃晚饭，我们开始担心起来。

entries.meaningZh: 把事物联系起来理解
entries.en: Students can relate these ancient trading routes to the ports shown on modern maps.
entries.zh: 学生可以将这些古代贸易路线与现代地图上的港口联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 数量或情况丝毫不差地
entries.en: The repaired clock struck exactly twelve as we stepped through the doorway.
entries.zh: 我们走进门口时，修好的钟恰好敲响了十二点。

entries.meaningZh: 协议或法律中的具体规定
entries.en: One provision of the lease allows tenants to keep a small pet.
entries.zh: 租约的一项条款允许租户养一只小宠物。

entries.meaningZh: 实际使用某物或服务的人
entries.en: Each user can adjust the screen brightness without changing anyone else's settings.
entries.zh: 每位用户都可以调整屏幕亮度，而不改变其他人的设置。

entries.meaningZh: 首要或最重要的
entries.en: The prime reason for choosing this flat was its proximity to work.
entries.zh: 选择这套公寓的首要原因是它离工作地点近。

entries.meaningZh: 团结一致共同努力的
entries.en: The village remained united throughout the long campaign to save its school.
entries.zh: 在争取保住学校的长期行动中，全村始终团结一致。

entries.meaningZh: 完成某事所遵循的步骤
entries.en: The guide explains the procedure for borrowing equipment from the community workshop.
entries.zh: 这份指南说明了从社区工坊借用设备的流程。

entries.meaningZh: 影响事情发展的具体情况
entries.en: One unusual circumstance made the repair difficult: the room had no windows.
entries.zh: 一个特殊情况使维修变得困难：房间没有窗户。

entries.meaningZh: 接受专业服务并付费的客户
entries.en: The architect showed her client three possible designs for the narrow house.
entries.zh: 建筑师向客户展示了这座狭窄房屋的三种可行设计。

entries.meaningZh: 与群体的生活传统及艺术有关的
entries.en: The museum explores the cultural importance of weaving in coastal communities.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆探讨了编织在沿海社区中的文化意义。

entries.meaningZh: 由学校或老师教导的学生
entries.en: Each pupil planted a bean and measured its growth over six weeks.
entries.zh: 每位学生都种下一颗豆子，并在六周内测量它的生长情况。

entries.meaningZh: 收藏并提供书籍供人阅读的场所
entries.en: The library lends gardening equipment as well as books about growing vegetables.
entries.zh: 这家图书馆既出借园艺工具，也出借有关种菜的书。

entries.meaningZh: 在听众面前发表讲话的人
entries.en: The final speaker answered questions about keeping bees on city rooftops.
entries.zh: 最后一位演讲者回答了关于在城市屋顶养蜂的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 文章或页面上写出的文字
entries.en: The text is printed beside the illustration in a large, clear font.
entries.zh: 文字以清晰的大号字体印在插图旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 不用费太多力气地
entries.en: The new handle lets my grandmother open the heavy door easily.
entries.zh: 新的门把手让奶奶能轻松打开那扇沉重的门。

entries.meaningZh: 问题或情况开始出现
entries.en: Unexpected questions often arise when children examine real objects rather than pictures.
entries.zh: 孩子观察实物而非图片时，常会冒出意想不到的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 生物分类中具有共同特征的一种
entries.en: This species of butterfly lays its eggs only on one type of plant.
entries.zh: 这种蝴蝶只在一种植物上产卵。

entries.meaningZh: 供电脑执行任务的程序
entries.en: The editing software lets me remove background noise from old family recordings.
entries.zh: 这款编辑软件能让我去除旧家庭录音中的背景噪声。

entries.meaningZh: 提供法律服务的执业律师
entries.en: Their attorney reviewed the contract before they agreed to sell the land.
entries.zh: 他们同意出售土地之前，律师审阅了合同。

entries.meaningZh: 必须满足的条件
entries.en: A basic safety course is a requirement for joining the sailing club.
entries.zh: 完成一门基础安全课程是加入帆船俱乐部的必要条件。

entries.meaningZh: 供火车行驶的轨道运输线路
entries.en: The disused railway has become a walking route through the valley.
entries.zh: 这条废弃铁路已变成穿过山谷的步行路线。

entries.meaningZh: 长时间直直地看着
entries.en: I could only stare at the enormous whale beneath our small boat.
entries.zh: 我只能目不转睛地看着我们小船下方那头巨大的鲸。

entries.meaningZh: 比山低矮的隆起地形
entries.en: From the grassy hill, we could see the entire curve of the bay.
entries.zh: 从长满青草的小山上，我们可以看到海湾完整的弧线。

entries.meaningZh: 按平常情况而言
entries.en: The bakery normally closes at six, but it stays open later on Fridays.
entries.zh: 面包店平常六点关门，但周五会营业得更晚。

entries.meaningZh: 在头脑中将两者联系起来
entries.en: I always associate the smell of pine with childhood holidays in the mountains.
entries.zh: 松树的气味总让我联想到童年在山里度过的假期。

entries.meaningZh: 眼睛看清事物的能力
entries.en: His vision improved enough to read the smaller signs across the street.
entries.zh: 他的视力有所改善，已经能看清街对面较小的标牌。

entries.meaningZh: 运送货物的大型汽车
entries.en: A delivery truck blocked the lane while workers unloaded boxes of oranges.
entries.zh: 工人卸下一箱箱橙子时，一辆送货卡车挡住了车道。

entries.meaningZh: 长期延续并传下来的习惯
entries.en: Sharing homemade soup after the harvest is a tradition in our family.
entries.zh: 收获后一起喝自家煮的汤，是我们家的传统。

entries.meaningZh: 一年中最寒冷的季节
entries.en: We store the garden chairs indoors when winter brings the first frost.
entries.zh: 冬季迎来初霜时，我们把花园椅子收进室内。

entries.meaningZh: 供人行走的狭窄道路
entries.en: A winding path leads from the village square to the ruined tower.
entries.zh: 一条蜿蜒的小路从村庄广场通向残破的塔楼。

entries.meaningZh: 仅仅达到所说的程度
entries.en: The note was merely a reminder, so no immediate reply was needed.
entries.zh: 这张便条只是一个提醒，因此不需要立即回复。

entries.meaningZh: 仔细观看以了解情况
entries.en: We sat quietly beside the pond to observe the frogs at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，我们静静地坐在池塘边观察青蛙。

entries.meaningZh: 帮助完成具体工作的器具
entries.en: This curved tool helps gardeners remove weeds without disturbing nearby roots.
entries.zh: 这件弯曲的工具帮助园丁拔除杂草，同时不扰动附近的根。

entries.meaningZh: 用来检验整体情况的少量部分
entries.en: The scientist collected a water sample from the stream below the farm.
entries.zh: 科学家从农场下方的小溪采集了一份水样。

entries.meaningZh: 体积小得很不显眼的
entries.en: A tiny crab disappeared beneath a shell when my shadow crossed the sand.
entries.zh: 我的影子掠过沙滩时，一只小螃蟹躲到了贝壳下面。

entries.meaningZh: 行动希望实现的目标
entries.en: Our main objective is to make the riverside path accessible to wheelchairs.
entries.zh: 我们的主要目标是让轮椅能够通行河边小路。

entries.meaningZh: 在大部分情况下或程度上
entries.en: The audience consisted mostly of students, with a few teachers near the back.
entries.zh: 观众大多是学生，后排附近还有几位老师。

entries.meaningZh: 对某人或某事可靠性的信任
entries.en: Her steady progress restored my faith in the team's ability to finish.
entries.zh: 她稳步取得的进展恢复了我对团队能够完成任务的信心。

entries.meaningZh: 尽管存在上述情况仍然如此
entries.en: The climb was steep; nevertheless, everyone reached the lookout before sunrise.
entries.zh: 山路很陡；尽管如此，所有人都在日出前到达了观景点。

entries.meaningZh: 源自普通民众传统的
entries.en: She learned several folk songs from a neighbour who remembered their oldest verses.
entries.zh: 她从一位记得最古老歌词的邻居那里学会了几首民歌。

entries.meaningZh: 来到某处参观或拜访的人
entries.en: Each visitor receives a map showing the safest routes through the gardens.
entries.zh: 每位游客都会领到一张标有园内最安全路线的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 在一个未明确指出的地方
entries.en: I left my gloves somewhere between the ticket office and the platform.
entries.zh: 我把手套落在售票处和站台之间的某个地方了。

entries.meaningZh: 由立法机关制定的法律或一组法律。
entries.en: The proposed legislation would require clearer labels on household cleaning products.
entries.zh: 拟议中的法规将要求家用清洁产品采用更清晰的标签。

entries.meaningZh: 做事或表现自己的方式
entries.en: The guide spoke in a calm manner that reassured the nervous children.
entries.zh: 导游以平静的方式说话，让紧张的孩子们安心了。

entries.meaningZh: 用球棒击球并跑垒的运动
entries.en: We watched baseball from the grassy slope beyond the stadium's outer fence.
entries.zh: 我们在体育场外围栏外的草坡上观看棒球比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 不限定具体身份的任何人
entries.en: Does anybody know where the spare key for this cupboard is kept?
entries.zh: 有人知道这个橱柜的备用钥匙放在哪里吗？

entries.meaningZh: 在现在所说的时间以前
entries.en: The room had previously served as a kitchen before becoming an art studio.
entries.zh: 这间房在改成艺术工作室之前，曾经用作厨房。

entries.meaningZh: 围绕神圣信念形成的信仰体系
entries.en: The course examines how religion has influenced architecture in different parts of the world.
entries.zh: 这门课程探讨了宗教如何影响世界不同地区的建筑。
